notes: Pair each World Cup Soccer jet-bumper switch (public 81 Left, 82 Upper, 83 Lower) with the jet-bumper coil the ROM fires for it (public solenoids 9, 10, 11). Direct switch writes only, so PinMAME keyboard handling and the built-in simulator stay off. The coin-door switch and the five normalized trough optos are presented closed, credits are added through coin switch 1, the fresh-NVRAM notice is cleared through Begin Test and three Escapes, and a game is started; once the trough eject (public solenoid 6) proves a game is running, the served ball is reported leaving the trough, resting on the shooter switch and leaving it. Each jet-bumper switch is then pulsed alone with a settle interval, in two different orders, so every coil pulse is attributable to the one switch that changed before it. This proves the ROM's switch-to-coil pairing only, not which physical bumper either address belongs to.
